categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Touches src/interfaces/wallet.h only mechanically to propagate WalletError return types from wallet operations.
categories.rationale: Mechanical interface signature changes that merely follow wallet-internal refactoring do not fall under IPC.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet key management, encryption transactions, and database state handling across src/wallet/.
categories.rationale: Prevents key leakage and node aborts by ensuring encryption and key persistence state changes are atomic. DB commit failures during passphrase changes or encryption previously could abort the process with `assert(false)`, leave plaintext keys un-erased on disk, or leave locked/unlocked state desynchronized between memory and disk.
